notes: New: More detail, about twice as slow. Tick it when you take 1080p video to 4K and want sharper edges and a cleaner picture: it runs the larger model and takes about 1.7 times as long. A strong denoise (0.5 or higher) already uses that model on HD video, and the Denoise slider now says so. Free exports of upscaling, restoring and colour work still stop at 60 seconds; Convert, Mute, Compress, Loop and the other tools run at full length, all with the small “Made with Crisp” mark. Pro, $129 once, removes the limit and the mark.
